fluff.overview: Infantry within the Legiones Marianes form the backbone of planetary garrison and territorial defense, freeing the Hegemony's limited BattleMech assets for offensive operations and prestige assignments. A centuria, or century, is the Marian equivalent of a company-sized formation. Mechanized hover centuries mount their troops in hovercraft that provide the fastest ground transport available to Marian infantry, capable of crossing water obstacles and open ground at speeds that wheeled or tracked vehicles cannot match. Armed with standard ballistic assault rifles, the most common and affordable infantry weapon available, these formations deliver reliable short-range firepower and can be equipped and resupplied from almost any garrison stockpile.
